artifacts.caption: Initial entry-page capture showing the Cloudflare verification wall.

Rendered browser view from discoverability capture.
Security headers observed on the Cloudflare challenge response; not treated as target-site evidence.
Attempted sitemap retrieval returned Cloudflare challenge HTML, not a sitemap.
